name: us-divorce-alimony-and-property
description: How a US divorce or separation is treated on the federal income tax return for 2026. Alimony under an instrument executed after 2018 (or a pre-2019 instrument modified to adopt the new rule) is neither deductible by the payer nor income to the recipient; alimony under an older instrument stays deductible and taxable. Property transfers between spouses or incident to divorce under section 1041 carry no gain or loss and the recipient takes the transferor's basis (1 year, or 6 years under the instrument). Filing status follows marital status on 31 December (section 7703), with the head of household route for a spouse living apart. The child dependency release on Form 8332, and retirement plan splits under a qualified domestic relations order (QDRO) with no 10% early distribution tax. Includes the decision case of filing jointly or separately in the final married year, with 2026 brackets from Rev. Proc. 2025-32.
